key_provisions_or_claims: Ethical consideration statements in AI research are superficial; a priori ethical and risk assessment is needed.
Applies EU Trustworthy AI Guidelines and risk analysis to an LLM-enabled social robot platform for autistic children.
Identifies 68 perceived risks and opportunities for children and caregivers.
Proposes an action plan: communication, assessment and system design plans.
Notes methodological gaps and lack of empirical evidence to assess major risks.
named_instruments_referenced: EU Ethics Guidelines for Trustworthy AI
annotation.summary_en: Internal research report (ORBilu record) arguing for a priori ethics and risk assessment of HRI applications. It assesses a platform combining social robots and LLMs for caregivers of autistic children, using EU Trustworthy AI guidelines, expert interviews and literature, identifying 68 risks and opportunities and proposing an action plan.
annotation.title_clean: Risk and Ethics Assessment of HRI Applications before Deployment: Large Language Models in Social Robots for Children with Autism
annotation.title_en: Risk and Ethics Assessment of HRI Applications before Deployment: Large Language Models in Social Robots for Children with Autism
